description: This file defines constants used for JWT token testing, including generating valid and expired JWT tokens, and managing associated cryptographic keys.

classes.name: JwtTestConstants
classes.description: A class containing static constants and methods for JWT token creation used in tests.

methods.name: createJwt
methods.description: Creates a valid JWT token with specific header and issuer, signed with a private key.

methods.name: createExpiredJwt
methods.description: Creates an expired JWT token with specific header and issuer, signed with a private key.
